title: Replace
prompt: Return the text with every copy of old swapped for new.
signature: func solve(text: String, old: String, new: String) -> String:
starter:
func solve(text: String, old: String, new: String) -> String:
	return text
hint: The replace method takes what to look for and what to put in its place.
solution:
func solve(text: String, old: String, new: String) -> String:
	return text.replace(old, new)
